# Supported finite correction and protective handoff

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every law of change with admissible disturbances and a guard, a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n (levels within the guard, every admissible step from level k+1 landing at level k), and exactly when every necessary family holds it there; a family that is both is exactly lasting. The market's support cover K0=5, K(n+1)=(10/9)(K(n)+1+kappa) is a ladder for the essential floor under every correction schedule and every shock at most kappa, and at the worst share it is exact: the stock alone lasts n steps at or above 5 exactly when it is at least K_n. So every physical state of the original rational market model with positive renewal share has a finite beta=0 correction horizon N (an instance of the reaching law, the case beta=0 of the landing side); initial support above K_N, including extra per-step consumption, makes every pulse step executable and lets the actual arrived state satisfy the original beta=1/2 perpetual protection certificate after withdrawal.

Canonical source: [RegimeTransition.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/RegimeTransition.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Original x,q,w update law, x,q,w in [0,1], x>0; beta=0 actually holds during the pulse with other example parameters retained, followed by beta=1/2.
- Extra support consumption kappa>=0 per pulse step; C0>=K_N with K0=5 and K(n+1)=(10/9)(K(n)+1+kappa); original monetary funding remains paid before receipts, with no other shocks.

Intervention is an effective change in shared operating relations; its formation, authority and implementation remain supplied correspondence. Kappa covers designated support units, not a common scale for every living and institutional cost.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 actually checks 27 new theorems / 35 declaration audits, separately rebuilding 96 inherited theorems / 118 audits. Author counterreview is integrated; no independent agent acceptance or new empirical calibration. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Sufficient finite-transition conditions, not a complete recovery region or minimal cost; proportional states, actual beta change, initial support and new entry retain separate correspondence obligations.

- Zero renewal share does not regenerate; no fixed pulse duration works for all positive shares; floor-level stock can fail on the first effective correction step even without extra consumption. [RegimeTransition.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/RegimeTransition.lean)
